Title: Public Preview: Azure Site Recovery support for Azure Trusted Launch VMs (Windows OS)

Body.Content: We are excited to announce the Public Preview of Azure Site Recovery support for Azure Trusted Launch VMs. Azure Trusted Launch VMs provide foundational compute security to Azure Generation 2 VMs by enabling Secure Boot and vTPM capabilities.  Please note that this public preview is for Windows OS only. Click here to learn more.
